title: Provide min / max value in slider headers and footer.
body: It would be nice to have in the documentation some examples of the header and footer using function instead of string.

comments.body:
Hi @hugo-ruivo-dw thanks for opening this issue.

The information is not available in the templates but indeed this could be useful. However I'm not sure how feasible it is.

Do you mean adding the currently _selected_ minimum and maximum, or the values that you set while initialising the widget? If you mean the initialised values, you should be able to put them in a variable before writing the widget code, and use the same value, or just copy and paste the values.
I mean the currently selected minimum and maximum.
@oscarhandsome This is currently not feasible with the current API. However, your feedback is greatly appreciated – we'll let you know if we make the bound values available.

> @oscarhandsome This is currently not feasible with the current API. However, your feedback is greatly appreciated – we'll let you know if we make the bound values available.
